• We use the future perfect tense ("**will have been playing**") to indicate an action that will start in the future (tomorrow) and continue up to a specific point in the future.
 
• This tense is appropriate because it aligns with the timeframe mentioned in the sentence.

(किसी काम, सामान, सेवा आदि के लिए भुगतान करना) • **Example**: *She is very well paid.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as the other options do not make sense in the context provided. • So, the correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage*:* Dill ate, and ate and ate. He hadn’t eaten since__ last night. He used all his money for a ticket, __boarded__ the train, as he had done many times, coolly chatted with the conductor, to __whom__ Dill was a familiar sight, but he had not the nerve to invoke the rule on small children travelling a distance alone; if you’ve lost your money the conductor will __lend__ you enough for dinner and your father will __**pay**__ him back at the end of the line. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Take"** means to accept or receive something. (किसी को लेना या ले जाना; किसी के साथ कहीं जाना) • **"Lend"** means to give someone something temporarily, with the expectation that it will be returned. (थोड़े समय के लिए उधार देना) • **"Charge"** means to demand payment for something. (क़ीमत माँगना, दाम माँगना) 92:T7a5, The correct answer is **"are graded."**
